title: locally optimal solutions to constraint displacement problems via path-obstacle overlaps
core_idea: Present a unified approach for constraint displacement problems where a robot attains a feasible path by displacing constraints/obstacles via a two-stage process: (1) compute a trajectory through obstacles while minimizing an objective, (2) displace obstacles to make that trajectory collision-free, yielding locally optimal obstacle displacements.
tldr: A two-stage method that first computes an objective-minimizing trajectory through obstacles and then displaces obstacles to render that trajectory collision-free, producing locally optimal constraint displacements for motion planning.
